rules.statement: When the repository has both a root README and a package README, guidance the change adds to one (or that the pull request description says both carry) must appear in the other as well, in the same words.
rules.why: Readers of the NuGet package page see only the package README, so guidance missing there leaves them without it and leaves the change only partly done.
rules.check: In a diff that adds or changes guidance in README.md or a package README, compare the two READMEs and the PR description; flag guidance present in one but missing from the other.
